description.p: PDFApps is a fast, offline, all-in-one PDF editor and manager. No subscriptions, no cloud uploads, no account required — your files never leave your computer.

ul.li: Split PDFs by page ranges
Merge multiple PDFs with drag-and-drop ordering
Rotate, extract, and reorder pages
Compress with three quality levels
Add page numbers in six positions with four formats
N-up layout: 2, 4, 6, 9, or 16 pages per sheet
Encrypt and decrypt with passwords
Add watermarks and stamps
OCR for scanned documents (5 languages)
Convert to PNG, JPG, DOCX, or TXT
Visual editor: redact, text, images, signatures, highlights, notes
Import TXT, images, or Markdown to PDF
View document metadata

description.p: Features include continuous scroll viewer, presentation mode (F5), fullscreen (F11), search, tabbed viewing, dark/light themes, and 8 language interface.

screenshot.caption: Convert PDF to images, Word, or text

description.p: Compression fixes, overwrite prompts and security updates:

ul.li: Compression no longer removes colour gradients; PDFs with gradients compress less without Ghostscript
Compression no longer turns pages to follow the direction of their text
Compression keeps the OCR text layer and, in most cases, links, form values, attachments and metadata
On Linux, compression runs Ghostscript with the system's own libraries
Converter and Import ask before replacing an existing file
AUR pdfapps-bin: no more checksum failure on update, and missing dependencies declared
AppImage, winget, Copr, Flatpak and the GitHub .msix are retired; use the Snap, the AUR or the tar.gz
Security: pypdf 6.21.2 or later, closing three CVEs; Pillow 13 on Python 3.11 or later; Ghostscript 10.08.0 in the Windows installer

description.p: OCR and compression fixes, and security updates:

ul.li: OCR runs in the language you pick, instead of the first installed one
The OCR language list shows only installed languages and keeps your choice
Chinese and Dutch appear in the OCR language list under their translated names
Running OCR no longer closes the app when an old or unrecognised Tesseract is installed
OCR and compression no longer open a console window on Windows
OCR fixed in the Snap package, which could not find its bundled language files
Compression in the Snap package now runs its stronger stage, which it skipped before
Compressing some damaged PDFs on Linux no longer hangs for about two minutes
Starting from a terminal no longer prints a deprecation notice
The Help button opens the current documentation page
Security: pypdf 6.19.0, closing three advisories present in 1.15.0, and urllib3 2.8.0, closing three

description.p: Password fixes and a stronger encryption stack:

ul.li: Correct passwords with accented or non-English characters are no longer rejected by the tools after unlocking
The password spelling that worked is reused across the viewer and every tool
A wrong password now shows a clear translated message
AES-256 encryption fixed in the Flatpak build, where a missing cryptography module made it fail
Security: pypdf 6.16.2 and cryptography 50.0.1, closing seven advisories

description.p: OCR language packs installed through Homebrew are now detected on Apple Silicon Macs.
Viewer stability, legacy-encoding imports, and security updates:

ul.li: The shared document handle stays valid after a failed note deletion, and saving no longer races with rendering
In-document search is debounced, so typing a query no longer blocks the interface
Text files in Windows-1252 and Latin-1 encodings now import without errors
Security updates to pillow, pymupdf, pypdf, and qtawesome

description.p: Page thumbnails sidebar in the viewer:

ul.li: A Pages tab shows a live thumbnail of every page; click one to jump to it
Thumbnails render on demand and stay sharp on high-DPI displays
A Contents tab shows the document outline when a PDF has bookmarks
Password-protected documents are verified correctly when opened for viewing

description.p: Editor audit fixes, atomic saves, and streaming OCR:

ul.li: Encryption is preserved on save and annotation deletions persist
Atomic writes with restore-on-error added across the tools
Streaming OCR writer lowers peak memory use
PDF to DOCX conversion is now layout-aware

description.p: Five new import formats and four new export formats:

ul.li: Import DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, and EPUB to PDF
Convert PDF to PPTX, XLSX, HTML, and EPUB
Global keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+O/S/P/W)
Multi-select PDFs in file dialog and drag & drop
Canvas background adapts to light/dark theme
Theme-aware dialogs in light mode

description.p: Digital signature tool, continuous scroll editor, and security hardening.
